children: European shares rose on Monday, led by banking stocks as oil prices eased on hopes of Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire, while investors awaited the start of the earnings season for fresh catalysts.
gained 0.43% to  634.25 points by 0709 GMT. Spain's bank-heavy IBEX
jumped 1.3%, the most among regional peers.

Oil prices slipped on expectations of more Russian supplies after US President Donald Trump said Ukraine and Russia had agreed to halt attacks on each other's energy facilities following a US-Russian diesel-supply deal.
Eurozone bond yields eased on Monday, further helping lift sentiment for riskier assets.
Investors now will be eyeing earnings reports from corporate Europe to gauge the health of companies amid geopolitical uncertainty and higher borrowing costs.
